pages.text: Natural progression, cause and effect following the clockwork logic of physical law. Cycles of growth and decay.$(br2)Random ticks can be turned into time spirits. If a block influence of a time hallow would be randomly ticked, it will yield nine time spirits instead (so long as the time hallow has room).

If an entity enters a block focus influenced by a time hallow, it will become "paused" - arrows will freeze midair, TNT will stop counting down, mobs will stop moving, and so on. Keeping an entity paused consumes one time spirit per second. Time- and Fate-aligned mobs are immune to this effect.
